chunks: A number of our companions, from our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Ali ibn Aamir, from Ibrahim ibn al-Fadl, from Ja'far ibn Yahya, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Eat the aubergine, for it removes the illness and there is no disease in it.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of aubergine according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the therapeutic value of aubergine, describing it as a potent remedy that eliminates disease. This narration reflects the broader Shia tradition of *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine), where specific foods are viewed not merely as sustenance but as divine prescriptions for maintaining physical and spiritual health.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Ali Bin Aamir, from Ibrahim Bin Al Fazl, from Ja’far Bin Yahya, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Eat the aubergine for it removes the illness and there is no disease in it’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘ Abd Allah ibn Ali ibn ‘Amir from Ibrahim ibn al-Fadl from Ja‘far ibn Yahya from his father who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Eat eggplant because it removes illnesses and does not cause any illness/”
